m.name: KanjiVG
m.author: Ulrich Apel
m.changes: Stroke ends extended along their direction; the stroke of each dakuten / handakuten mark moved to the position of the mark in the Klee One glyph.

n.name: KanjiVG
n.author: Ulrich Apel
n.changes: Positions of the numbers of the dakuten / handakuten strokes moved with the marks, and some numbers moved so that the number badges do not overlap.

transform: x109 = scale * xFont + dx; y109 = -scale * yFont + dy (font units, unitsPerEm 1000)
check: raster 218x218; cov = glyph pixels inside the union of centerlines stroked at width 13.0 (ends extended by 4.0); ins = min over strokes of centerline pixels inside the glyph dilated by 2.0; score = min(cov, ins); leak = share of glyph pixels whose nearest centerline is a later stroke but that an earlier stroke's mask already reveals
